note: Facility registry (20 r2 section 3.4). One entry per priced facility; adding a facility is a data change. Every holiday list names its source.

holidays.note: ETR names no holidays; it says Ontario statutory holidays, which the Employment Standards Act lists as these nine. Civic Holiday, Easter Monday and Remembrance Day are NOT included. date_rule=actual: a holiday falling on a weekend is weekend-priced anyway, and no substitute weekday is assumed (ETR publishes none) - verify against a statement.

facilities.ramp_rule_note: A ramp plaza is charged only when a GPS fix lies within 20 m of that ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline (decided 2026-11-06). Distance to the booth is never used: 30 of 61 CFX ramp booth clusters lie within 50 m of the mainline. Sparse fixes can miss a ramp, so CFX estimates may still run slightly low; 4 ramp clusters cannot be proven (Schofield Road's 2, which have no OSM ramp shape; Boggy Creek/McCoy and Semoran, which never separate 30 m from the mainline) and are never charged.
facilities.rate_schedule: single rate, all days and times: the CFX schedule publishes no peak, off-peak or holiday rates

facilities.cards_note: Each passage is charged from the card in effect on its Chicago-local date. The board approved the 2027 card on 2026-08-19; from 2029 rates move every two years by CPI-U (max 8%), so a new card is due before 2029-01-01.
facilities.payment_column_note: Fleet decision: priced as license-plate billing. Pay By Plate is 2x I-PASS in 2026 and 1.5x from 2027; an unregistered plate billed by invoice pays 2x (2027) or 2x plus a $3 fee per toll (2026), so a vehicle on invoice is under-estimated and one with an I-PASS is over-estimated.
facilities.ramp_rule_note: As CFX: a ramp plaza is charged only when a fix lies within 20 m of the ramp's OSM shape and at least 30 m from the mainline. Eola Road (60) and Ogden Avenue (81) are mainline on the card but every gantry sits on a ramp, so they take the ramp rule. Where one plaza number is priced per movement (Genoa Road, Illinois 47, Barrington Road, Roselle Road) the ramp's geometry picks the movement; see gantries/istha.json.
facilities.rate_schedule: passenger rates have a single rate, all days and times; only truck rates vary (daytime/overnight)
